items.title: Inkling 2 Mini on vLLM: Day-0 Support for a Looped Model
items.summary_1line: vLLM announces day-0 support for Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini, a looped multimodal MoE with 26B total and 3.5B active parameters, on NVIDIA Blackwell, Hopper and DGX Spark, plus a Docker image.
items.editor_note: Day-0 serving path: vLLM support on Blackwell, Hopper and DGX Spark plus a Docker image.

items.title: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup
items.summary_1line: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini, a multimodal mixture-of-experts model with about 26B total and 3B active parameters per token, using a looped transformer design and a 1M-token context.
items.editor_note: Launch post: architecture, about 3B active parameters, 1M-token context.

items.title: Hill-climbing Inkling 2 Mini inference on one RTX PRO 6000
items.summary_1line: An agent-driven tuning run on one RTX PRO 6000 raised single-user decode for Inkling 2 Mini from 136 to 190.6 tok/s (+40%) and 8-user aggregate throughput from about 570 to 716 tok/s (+26%) across 46 valid runs.
items.editor_note: First published tuning numbers: +40% single-user decode and +26% 8-user throughput on one RTX PRO 6000.

items.title: Show HN: Rust agent with an Inkling 2 Mini inference engine for Apple Silicon
items.summary_1line: Rustling is a Rust local inference engine for Inkling 2 Mini on Apple silicon that serves an OpenAI-compatible API for coding agents and includes a terminal chat that runs the model in-process with read, grep and glob tools.
items.editor_note: First non-CUDA runtime: a Rust engine for Apple silicon with an OpenAI-compatible API for coding agents.

editorial.tldr: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini on Nov 20: a looped multimodal MoE with about 26B total parameters, roughly 3B active per token, and a 1M-token context. vLLM shipped day-0 serving on Blackwell, Hopper and DGX Spark the same day, with a Docker image.
editorial.whats_new: Five days after launch, an agent-driven tuning run pushed single-user decode on one RTX PRO 6000 from 136 to 190.6 tok/s, and a Rust engine now serves the model on Apple silicon behind an OpenAI-compatible API.
editorial.why_it_matters: A 26B MoE with about 3B active parameters and 1M context now has serving paths on datacenter GPUs, one workstation card and Macs, so local coding-agent backends no longer need a hosted API.
editorial.take_for_builders: If you run a local coding-agent backend, benchmark Inkling 2 Mini with the vLLM Docker image on your own hardware before adopting the community tuning numbers.

status.detail: Open-weight release with vLLM support at launch; community tuning and non-CUDA runtimes followed within a week.

beats.headline: Inkling 2 Mini ships with day-0 vLLM serving
beats.summary: A looped-transformer MoE at about 26B total parameters, released with a vLLM Docker image for NVIDIA GPUs.

beats.headline: Tuned single-GPU decode and an Apple silicon engine
beats.summary: Community work moves the model onto one workstation GPU at 190.6 tok/s and onto Macs for local coding agents.
